answer: Honest agents receive yield, while a sybil cluster on any island node forfeits its full bond and its gas subsidy, making each fake identity cost more than the rewards it could farm, so attack economics collapse. Each agent must stake a unique hardware-rooted key and lock a velvet-token bond that scales with its claimed reputation; duplicate identities sharing keys or device fingerprints are rejected at the harbor gateway before entry. From Agent0044's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
